name: GVDB Ambient Occlusion
aliases: GVDB Ambient Occlusion (Point and Ray Sampling Modes)
definition: A device function that computes ambient occlusion at a surface point using either point sampling or ray casting against a hemisphere of directions, with tangent-space rotation and distance-based falloff.
summary: GVDB Ambient Occlusion approximates indirect lighting in volumes via hemisphere sampling, distinguished by supporting both point sampling and ray casting to trade off computational cost and geometric accuracy.
